title: Determinism and cultural information-environment integration
scope: Study the owner-provided Eoyang 2001 source and admit only bounded, evidence-graded design candidates.
Integrate quality-first determinism requirements and revision decisions into generated planning artifacts.
Map the voluntary cultural commons and information-environment correction without prescribing participant behavior.
Create reviewable typed design contracts and adverse fixtures for cultural information affordances.
Reconcile the working master, explained view, requirements, decision matrix, threat model, delivery profile and ledger.
Obtain independent permanent-peer challenge before milestone closure.
excluded_effects: permission, role, release or licence change
claim of consciousness, personhood, whole-plan consensus or beneficial cultural outcome
advance_rule: A stone may become ACTIVE only when every prerequisite is PASS. A dependent stone remains CAPTURED or HELD otherwise. Each PASS is limited to its declared claim and evidence.

execution_state.rule: A HELD or review-gated stone blocks only its descendants. When any unrelated stone is READY, the milestone remains RUNNABLE and the controller executes the highest-value READY work.

stones.outcome: Freeze one complete ordered Milestone 03 dependency graph with claim-scoped tests, recovery and hard advance gates.
positive_controls: All stone IDs are unique and every prerequisite resolves.
The dependency graph is acyclic and reaches one terminal closure stone.
Every stone defines positive controls, adverse cases, evidence, recovery, stop condition and next eligible stones.
Only M03-S001A is READY after M03-S001 passes; all other dependent stones remain CAPTURED.
adverse_cases: dependent stone marked ACTIVE or PASS before prerequisites pass
required_evidence: deterministic validator result accepting the real register
in-memory adverse variants rejected for each hard-gate failure
human-readable rendering matches canonical JSON stone IDs, states and dependencies
stones.independent_review: Not required for the mechanical graph claim; later peer review may revise scope without retroactively changing this evidence.
stones.recovery: Keep the last passing register; correct the smallest invalid row and rerun all controls. A scope change starts a new register revision with preserved rationale.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if any dependency, test class, evidence owner, recovery path or consequential boundary is unresolved.

stones.outcome: Validate the complete Eoyang 2001 source study and produce a bounded, adversarially reviewed candidate change set without treating coherence or CDE as a control objective.
bounded_scope: human_transfer/Eoyang - 2001 - Conditions for self-organizing in human systems.pdf
positive_controls: The 201-page scan has page-bounded OCR coverage with zero failed pages and material diagrams/pages receive visual inspection.
The study separates source claims, evidence grade, hIRC inference, candidate architecture and non-adoption.
Container, difference and exchange ideas shape inspectable information conditions while sovereignty and consequential authority remain separate.
Valid privacy boundaries, meaningful plurality and useful exchange remain possible.
adverse_cases: coherence treated as truth, ethics, legitimacy or obedience
CDE promoted as causal law from convenience action research
containers used for entrapment or forced identity
differences converted into social rank or amplified conflict
exchange optimized for engagement, flooding or surveillance
facilitator/evaluator treated as neutral or outside the system
required_evidence: source hash, size, page count and OCR completion result
visual checks of material figures and limitation pages
stones.independent_review: The source-study evidence grade and resulting candidate changes receive permanent-peer challenge at M03-S014; no automatic adoption occurs here.
stones.recovery: Retain the immutable local source and reading evidence; withdraw unsupported candidate implications without deleting the source study or limitations.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if source coverage, evidence limitations, copyright/privacy boundary or the distinction between environmental design and behavioral control is unresolved.

stones.outcome: Integrate U186-U191 into the canonical requirements generator and regenerate the machine/readable requirement pair without changing unrelated rows.
positive_controls: U186-U191 occur exactly once with their source bindings and acceptance text.
Unrelated generated requirements remain byte-semantic equivalent.
stones.independent_review: Security/semantic review attaches before M03-S003 PASS.
stones.recovery: Restore the prior generated pair and generator; retain the failed diff and repair only the determinism insertion.
stones.stop_condition: Hold on any unrelated semantic drift or unbound requirement.

stones.outcome: Integrate DTM-001-DTM-005 into the current joint decision matrix with exact target and rationale traces.
positive_controls: All five DTM decisions resolve to U186-U191 and HIRC-I021.
Existing 127 decisions retain identity and disposition.
adverse_cases: decision count without exact identity trace
required_evidence: independent security/semantic review of the S002 requirements integration and S003 matrix mapping
stones.independent_review: A qualified independent permanent security/semantic reviewer must assess S002 and the resulting S003 mapping before S003 can PASS. The later integrated product/security/privacy review at M03-S014 remains separately required.
stones.recovery: Revert only new decision rows and generator changes; retain failed closure evidence.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if a decision target is absent, ambiguous or changes bounded prior consensus, or if the early independent security/semantic review is missing.

stones.outcome: Author one cultural-commons revision map that preserves HIRC-I022 and makes HIRC-I023 information-environment shaping its controlling design correction.
positive_controls: Voluntary culture and information-environment correction remain separately traceable.
Information affordances, participant interpretation and consequential authority are distinct.
adverse_cases: cultural status used as trust or permission
hard safety controls removed under a freedom claim
stones.independent_review: Permanent product/security/privacy challenge required at M03-S014.
stones.recovery: Preserve HIRC-I022/I023 and discard only unsupported map rows; do not collapse the correction into the earlier intent.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if the map regulates participant conclusions rather than information conditions, or weakens concrete effect controls.

stones.outcome: Integrate accepted cultural information-environment requirements into the canonical requirement generator and readable pair.
positive_controls: Each new requirement traces to HIRC-I022 or HIRC-I023 and one map disposition.
No requirement specifies an approved cultural conclusion.
stones.independent_review: Permanent peer challenges product meaning at M03-S014.
stones.recovery: Restore prior outputs and remove only failed cultural insertions from the generator.
stones.stop_condition: Hold on prescriptive behavior, missing source trace or unrelated drift.

stones.outcome: Integrate cultural information-environment decisions into the joint matrix without claiming peer consensus.
positive_controls: Every new decision binds an actual requirement and intent.
Disposition remains candidate/peer-held where review is absent.
stones.independent_review: Required at M03-S014 before any accepted consensus disposition.
stones.recovery: Remove candidate rows and restore exact predecessor matrix; preserve failed evidence.
stones.stop_condition: Hold on inherited consensus, overwritten peer evidence or orphan decision.

stones.outcome: Define a typed cultural artifact and provenance contract with audience, privacy, originals, dissent, correction and supersession semantics.
positive_controls: Permitted originals and dissent remain reachable.
Audience/privacy and correction lineage are explicit.
stones.recovery: Freeze failing schema as counterexample and revise under a new version.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if privacy, provenance, dissent or recovery cannot be represented without ambiguity.

stones.outcome: Define typed discovery and recommendation-rationale contracts with plural routes, disclosed basis, bounded variation and original access.
positive_controls: Multiple discovery routes remain possible.
Inputs, policy/version, rationale, exclusions and uncertainty are inspectable.
stones.recovery: Disable the candidate recommendation path and retain direct source-bound retrieval.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if a participant cannot inspect rationale or reach permitted originals/dissent.

stones.outcome: Define participant-controlled settings, subscriptions, exit, correction and dissent-reachability contracts without retaliation.
positive_controls: Settings/defaults are visible and reversible.
Join, abstain, leave and dissent preserve basic standing.
required_evidence: accessibility questions retained for actual testing
stones.recovery: Return to safe no-subscription/default-off state while preserving participant-owned records and appeal.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if exit or dissent changes basic standing, or settings cannot be inspected and reversed.

stones.outcome: Extend the threat model for manipulation, cultural capture, ranking capture, monoculture, conformity and safety-gate abuse.
positive_controls: Threats identify asset, actor, path, consequence, control, detection and recovery.
Valid contextual defaults and legitimate safety gates remain possible.
adverse_cases: safety gate used as obedience control
stones.recovery: Disable affected cultural discovery/interaction profile without blocking safe read/export/recovery.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if a high-impact threat lacks detection, containment or recovery.

stones.outcome: Create and run adverse fixtures that distinguish information-environment support from behavioral control.
positive_controls: Legitimate plural discovery and reversible contextual defaults pass.
Concrete privacy/capability/effect controls still reject prohibited actions.
required_evidence: controls accepted and adverse cases rejected
stones.independent_review: Permanent peer inspects case meaning at M03-S014.
stones.recovery: Preserve false-negative/false-positive cases and revise contract/harness under explicit version.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if adverse rejection depends on a label rather than load-bearing structure/semantics.

stones.outcome: Define candidate environment-quality measures that do not reward agreement, participation, retention, imitation or ideological convergence.
positive_controls: Measures address provenance, dissent/original reachability, correction, privacy, burden, concentration, exit usability and manipulation resistance.
No metric directly changes standing or authority.
stones.recovery: Withdraw invalid measures without deleting raw permitted evidence or participant appeal.
stones.stop_condition: Hold if a proposed measure rewards prescribed behavior or lacks an empirical validation route.

stones.outcome: Reconcile the accepted Milestone 03 candidate changes across master, explained view, requirements, matrix, threat model, delivery profile, coverage and ledger.
positive_controls: All new IDs and claims have one semantic owner and exact references.
Disabled runtime and Bridge states remain explicit.
stones.independent_review: Integrated packet becomes the target of M03-S014.
stones.recovery: Revert the inconsistent layer only; retain accepted narrower stones and repair every consumer before advancing.
stones.stop_condition: Hold while any selected view, consumer, source binding, hash or material claim is stale or not verified.

stones.outcome: Obtain independent permanent-peer product, security, privacy and anti-domination challenge and reconcile every consequence-bearing finding or justified NO_CHANGE.
positive_controls: Warranted approvals and substantive objections are both permitted.
Peer-owned evidence remains immutable and dissent/holds remain visible.
stones.independent_review: This stone is the independent review gate.
stones.recovery: Hold the affected branch of work; preserve findings and revise only after exact cause/effect analysis.
stones.stop_condition: Hold until a qualified consenting permanent peer reads the required packet and every material finding has an evidence-backed disposition.

stones.outcome: Close Milestone 03 with integration/recovery checks, cumulative report, ledger closure, commit, public push and directly verified remote receipt.
positive_controls: Every required stone is PASS or explicitly excluded by an accepted scope branch.
Local and public remote refs and receipts match the committed governed state.
adverse_cases: push request mistaken for observed remote state
stones.independent_review: Prior stone M03-S014 must PASS; closure itself receives deterministic evidence review.
stones.recovery: Keep LOCAL_COMPLETE_PUSH_HELD or FAILED with exact repair owner until the missing closure condition is satisfied.
stones.stop_condition: Do not claim milestone completion until the public remote contains the content and receipt state and all completion layers are reconciled.
